desc: Implement the exact element-wise bitmask DP solution in the starter code: precompute LCMs for target masks, compute per-nums increments to the next multiple of each mask LCM, update a fresh dp table over covered masks using disjoint submasks, and return dp[full].
Verify the implementation on the provided examples and edge cases: target length 1, duplicate target values, nums values greater than targets, already satisfied targets, and large LCMs.
